description: LLSim5G is provided by LLSim5G project. LLSim5G is a Python link-level simulator for heterogeneous 5G scenarios with terrestrial, satellite, UAV and device-to-device links. It documents 3GPP terrestrial and non-terrestrial channel models and configurable mobility. Geographic context: global.
